clips.title: The story
paras: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf resident of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. Deeply loyal and observant, she watches over the tranquil grove and looks out for her companion Iverron when his reckless ventures land him in peril.

Dirania stands among the tranquil boughs of Shadowglen, the secluded vale where young night elves begin their service to Kalimdor and the Alliance. While many in the barrow mounds and sanctuaries look to broad spiritual duties, Dirania stays mindful of those nearest to her, attentive to the quiet dangers that stir even in the heart of Teldrassil.

Dirania's immediate concern is her companion Iverron. Overeager and careless around the poisonous woodland creatures creeping across the glen, Iverron frequently gets into trouble. When he succumbs to a venomous bite from the local webwood spiders, Dirania takes it upon herself to seek out willing hands to gather ingredients and prepare a remedy before the venom takes a permanent toll.
